title: E bike tapas tour Granada
text: Ruben was great he gave us both history and guidance on things only locals know such as the cheap beer and lovely views away from the tourist crowds. Definitely recommend this e bike tapas tour and ask for Ruben - great guide and sound dude!
author: H2462IUdavidj

title: Fabulous tour
text: Fabulous tour. Ruben gave us helmets, then made sure we were comfortable on our e-bikes. These two neighborhoods are super hilly. But no worries, e-bikes to the rescue!! There were 4 of us on the tour so it was easy to stay together. Ruben gave us great information about our frequent stops. We had multiple views of the Alahambra from across the way. This was a fun 2 hour tour.
author: B918OKlindad

title: Ruben was great!
text: Great tour of the city! Ruben was a great guide and the e-bikes were a fun way to see many key spots around town. Would recommend!

title: Amazing sunset views!
text: We did the Sunset Bike tour in Grenada and we would highly recommend it.  The views are amazing and it was a lot of fun.  Ruth, our guide, was excellent and really nice.   She even gave us nice restaurants recommendations at the end.

title: Amazing views, thanks Ruben!

title: Wonderful E-bike tour of Granada
text: Fares was an amazing guide for our E-bike tour of Granada at sunset. He was very engaging and took us on a wonderful evening tour. We got to see some great views of the city and a beautiful sunset!
